lines.text: The street was worse. They were coming from *everywhere.*

lines.text: Pull it up! Pull it up!
Below us, the dead moved like a *river.*
lines.style: Narrating, hushed awe and dread, slow and steady.

lines.text: A helicopter passed once. It didn't stop.
lines.style: Narrating, hope then quiet disappointment, steady pace.

lines.text: If anyone can hear this... the *lighthouse.*
lines.style: A tired man on a crackling emergency radio, urgent but broken up, a short gap before 'the lighthouse'.
